title: Bhoo Chetana - Rainfed Agriculture Productivity Improvement Programme
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

scheme_details.description: A programme designed to improve rain-fed crop productivity through soil testing, balanced nutrient management, improved agricultural inputs and scientific farming practices.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating rain-fed agricultural crops in areas covered by the programme
Farmers meeting the applicable department guidelines
farmer_category: Small and marginal farmers where eligible under applicable guidelines

money_benefits.subsidy: Historical Karnataka government records describe agricultural input distribution at a 50% subsidy under Bhoo Chetana. Current rates and eligible inputs require verification.
money_benefits.input_support: Eligible agricultural inputs and nutrients may be supplied according to programme guidelines.

scheme_details.water_irrigation_support: No specific borewell or irrigation subsidy independently verified for this scheme. Its primary focus is rain-fed agriculture, soil fertility and crop productivity.
application_process: Contact the nearest Raita Samparka Kendra or Agriculture Department office.
Ask whether Bhoo Chetana activities are being implemented in the farmer's village or district.
Confirm eligible crops, input distribution, soil testing and current subsidy conditions.
Provide the land and farmer details requested by the Agriculture Department.
Participate in soil sampling or testing if required.
Follow the soil nutrient and crop management recommendations issued by agricultural officials.
Receive eligible inputs or benefits after verification under the applicable guidelines.
benefits: Improves soil fertility and nutrient management
Promotes balanced use of macro and micronutrients
Improves productivity of selected rain-fed crops
scheme_details.implemented_by: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka, with watershed development support in the programme's historical implementation
target_beneficiaries: Farmers cultivating rain-fed crops in covered areas

data_source.notes: Historical programme information confirms the purpose and earlier implementation. Current availability, subsidy rates, document requirements and application windows have not been verified.
